Package com.pulumi.cloud.sdk

Class HeaderParsing

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.pulumi.cloud.sdk.HeaderParsing
  • public final class HeaderParsing
extends java.lang.Object
    Header-value parsing helpers for generated *Api methods whose response declares typed response headers. HttpHeaders.firstValue(java.lang.String) already gives a single-value accessor, but every numeric/boolean conversion still needs a default for a missing or unparsable header — Long.parseLong(null), or a malformed value, would otherwise throw.
